examples.question:
Has anyone done any studies on Aragonite calcium carbonate or do you know of anyone researching it? This is what our studies have shown. We are looking for any additional studies or someone who would do their own study if we provide the aragonite.

Benefits
- Improved drought resistance
- Reduced irrigation demand
- Enhanced microbial activity
- Increased yield consistency
- Reduced fertilizer usage (20–30% potential)

Strontium Contribution
Trace Sr enhances:
- Cell wall strength
- Stress tolerance
- Root development (at controlled levels)

AragoCor Minerals LLC
examples.nova_answer: Aragonite and calcite are two crystal forms of the same compound, CaCO3 [c:SHE-FA-2026-0011::c1]. Aragonite has been tested as a soil amendment [c:SHE-FA-2026-0011::c3].

examples.question: Where is the official USDA page for EQIP, and when did Soil Health Exchange last verify its EQIP entry?
examples.nova_answer: The official USDA page for EQIP is [https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/programs-initiatives/environmental-quality-incentives-program](https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/programs-initiatives/environmental-quality-incentives-program) [c:she_funding:usda-nrcs-eqip::c1]. Soil Health Exchange last verified its EQIP entry on November 14, 2026 [c:she_funding:usda-nrcs-eqip::c1].
examples.extractive_answer: Borrowers must have an EQIP award; prospective EQIP applicants can submit interest for support before an award [c:she_funding:food-system-six-eqip-bridge-loan::c1]. USDA NRCS Advancing Markets for Producers funds the project. **Readiness:** Prep docs first **Who can apply:** producer, Sheep and wool producers in California, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New York, South Dakota, Utah or Wyoming **Coverage:** CA, CO, ID, MT, NV, NY, SD, UT, WY **Deadline & timing:** The official site accepts producer applications with no posted application closing date as verified October 10, 2026 [c:she_funding:ncat-wool-quality-improvement::c1]. As of 2026-11-05; official url: https://www.foodsystem6.org/the-eqip-bridge-loan-program; these are program criteria as written on the page, not a determination that anyone qualifies [c:she_funding:food-system-six-eqip-bridge-loan::c1].
